CheckTitle: WebAuthn user verification is required where WebAuthn is used
Description: Checks broad app sign-in rules that allow WebAuthn and verifies user verification is required.
Risk: WebAuthn without required user verification can provide lower assurance that the legitimate user was present.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, go to Security > Authentication Policies > App sign-in.
2. Open policies and rules that allow Passkeys or FIDO2 WebAuthn.
3. Edit possession factor constraints for WebAuthn/Passkeys.
4. Set user verification to Required for authentication where supported.
5. Confirm enrollment settings do not conflict with the stricter app policy.

Recommendation.Text: Require user verification where WebAuthn or Passkeys are allowed so the authenticator verifies local user presence with a PIN or biometric.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
